from.place: quotient formal-fibre identification in the proof of Stacks 07PN

title: Quotient identification of formal fibres
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative ring and let q ≤ p be prime ideals. Put pbar = p/q in R/q, C = completion of (R/q)_pbar at its maximal ideal and Cp = completion of R_p at its maximal ideal. Then kappa(q) tensor_(R/q) C and kappa(q) tensor_R Cp are isomorphic as kappa(q)-algebras. The residue field and completions are those of [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion].

source.place: Lemma 07PN, displayed equality in its proof; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07PN

proof.text: The quotient map R → R/q is surjective. Its map on prime localizations is surjective by RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_surjective and SurjectiveOnStalks.localRingHom_surjective. IsLocalization.ker_map, the equality of mapped prime complements and Ideal.mk_ker identify its kernel with qR_p. IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective identifies its image maximal ideal.

Use Noetherianity of R_p and AdicCompletion.exists_local_completion_quotient for this localized surjection. Rewrite the target ideal as its maximal ideal and the extended kernel as q completion(R_p). The resulting ring equivalence e sends the quotient class of x to the induced completion map theta(x). Compatibility theta ∘ cA = cD ∘ phi upgrades e to an R-algebra equivalence.

AlgEquiv.extendScalarsOfSurjective extends the R-algebra equivalence to R/q, using surjectivity of R → R/q. Compose its inverse with Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor to identify the completion of (R/q)_(p/q) with (R/q) tensor_R completion(R_p) as R/q-algebras. Tensor this equivalence with the identity on kappa(q), as a kappa(q)-algebra equivalence using Algebra.TensorProduct.congr. Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange gives the required isomorphism to kappa(q) tensor_R completion(R_p).

mathlib_searches.query: Quotient identification of formal fibres of completion at a prime
The formal fibre of completion at p over q is isomorphic to generic formal fibre of the localized quotient R/q
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: Ideal.Fiber and localization residue-field/prime-spectrum lemmas; none identifies completions of prime quotients.
IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv and tensor localization lemmas; no completion-quotient fibre identification.

mathlib_searches.query: formal[Ff]ib|pairsOfPrimes; direct rg of lean/Sheaf/RingTheory and lean/WeilConjectures/RingTheory
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib search returned no hits. Project has forward/backward criterion and various formal-fibre regularity statements but no public quotient formal-fibre isomorphism. LocalCompletionQuotient supplies the completion quotient ingredient.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_formalFibre_quotient_algEquiv
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (q p : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime] [p.IsPrime] (hqp : q ≤ p) :
    let pbar := p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk q)
    letI : pbar.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_quotientMk_of_isPrime hqp
    let L := Localization.AtPrime pbar
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L) L
    let Cp := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p))
      (Localization.AtPrime p)
    Nonempty ((TensorProduct (R ⧸ q) q.ResidueField C) ≃ₐ[q.ResidueField] q.Fiber Cp)
